name: jev.bench
description: Gate a claim that a RIG-trained JEV/OpenJEV cross-encoder beats the published OpenJEV baselines across nine benchmark categories. Scores the evidence packet on a 0-10 ladder. Every category must average >= 9.5 across its five questions.

chess__measured_live.instructions: Was the Chess legal moves (4 candidate SAN moves, exactly one legal) metric produced by actually running the evaluation harness on the RIG-trained checkpoint, with the raw numeric output present in the evidence?

The chess metric is only promised, planned, or described as future work

Raw chess output, exact invocation, exit code, and a persisted results artifact path

chess__beats_baseline.instructions: Does the evidence show the RIG-trained head's Chess legal moves (4 candidate SAN moves, exactly one legal) score exceeding its OpenJEV baseline, with the baseline's source named? The baseline is OpenJEV's published 0.8B mlp_per_task for this category where OpenJEV published one; where OpenJEV published no 0.8B number for this category, the baseline is the released 0.8B checkpoint's own scorer re-measured locally on the identical items. Either is a valid baseline provided the evidence says which one is used.
